summary: Joseph Gentle, Australian, software engineer with 17 years of programming experience, former Google Wave developer, author of ShareJS, strong advocate for open-source software, critical of proprietary software practices, experienced in operational transformation (OT) and real-time collaborative editing, passionate about programming education, emphasizes readability and maintainability in code, interested in the intersection of technology and social issues, particularly privacy and data security, engaged in discussions about software development practices and community dynamics, enjoys teaching and mentoring, has a background in computer science education, actively participates in online tech communities, and has a keen interest in the evolution of programming languages and frameworks.
